silage-bag.context: A long ribbed plastic tube lying on the ground with a gathered, tied end. Marks silage and forage storage, livestock feed supplies and farm inventory.

grain-probe.context: A long slotted spear pushed at an angle into a mound of grain. Used for grain sampling, moisture and quality checks, and bin inspection.

grain-pile.context: A rounded heap of grain with a few loose kernels scattered around its base. Stands for harvested grain, stockpiles and grain storage levels.

sun-drying-grain.context: Grain spread flat on a mat with a rake resting against it and the sun overhead. Used for traditional post-harvest drying and threshing floors.

solar-dryer.context: A box on legs with a sloped glass lid, a tray of sliced produce inside and the sun above. Marks solar food drying and preservation of fruit and vegetables.

rice-drying-rack.context: A horizontal pole between two posts with bundles of harvested rice hanging along it. Used for field drying of rice sheaves after cutting.

hay-drying-rack.context: A wooden rail rack with a thick layer of hay draped over its top rail. Used for haymaking and curing forage in wet climates.

tobacco-curing-barn.context: A tall barn with a vent along the roof ridge and an open doorway showing hanging leaves. Marks tobacco curing, drying sheds and leaf processing.

coffee-drying-bed.context: A raised mesh table covered with a layer of round coffee cherries. Used for natural and sun drying of coffee at the farm.

cotton-module.context: A large rounded block of harvested cotton wrapped in plastic and strapped, standing on the ground. Marks cotton harvest storage and transport to the gin.

grain-engulfment.context: A warning triangle showing a person sinking chest deep into a heap of grain. Used for grain bin entrapment and suffocation hazards on farms.

tractor-rollover.context: A tractor tipping over on a slope with a roll bar frame above the seat. Marks tractor rollover hazards, rollover protection and farm machinery safety.

cotton-gin.context: A box shaped machine with a hand crank, raw cotton feeding in at the top and a roller inside. Marks cotton ginning and fibre and seed separation.

sugarcane-crusher.context: A pair of rollers on a frame with a crank handle, cane feeding in from above and a pan below catching the juice. Used for cane juice stalls and small sugar mills.

seed-oil-press.context: A screw press with a crossbar handle pressing seeds in a slotted cage while oil drips out below. Marks oil pressing and cold pressed oil production.

rice-huller.context: A machine with a hopper on top, a spout that pours out rice and a side vent that blows out husks. Marks rice hulling, milling and polishing.

fanning-mill.context: A box machine on legs with a hopper on top and a hand crank, grain falling out below while chaff blows out the side. Marks seed and grain cleaning.

chaff-cutter.context: A spoked wheel with curved blades at the end of a trough that holds straw. Used for cutting straw and fodder by hand for livestock.

pedal-thresher.context: A drum studded with wire loops on a stand with a foot pedal, with a bundle of stalks held against the drum. Marks foot powered rice threshing.

potato-harvester.context: A towed digging machine with a sloped conveyor belt lifting potatoes out of the soil, a wheel below and a tow hitch. Marks mechanical root crop harvest.

swather.context: A self propelled machine with a wide reel header at the front and an operator cab. Marks swathers and windrowers that cut hay and grain into rows.

subsoiler.context: A single long steel shank with a pointed foot hanging from a tractor frame and reaching below the soil line. Marks deep tillage and breaking up soil compaction.

jab-planter.context: A long handled hand planter with a seed box and pointed jaws that are jabbed into the soil. Used to sow corn and beans one hole at a time.

push-seeder.context: A single wheeled seeder with a small hopper above the wheel and a long handle, dropping seeds in a row as it is pushed. Used for vegetable and garden sowing.

three-point-hitch.context: The rear housing of a tractor with two lower lift arms and an upper link joined at a mast to form a triangle. Marks implement attachment and linkage.

pto-shaft.context: A telescoping drive shaft with a ribbed safety guard and a yoke joint at each end. Marks power take off drivelines between tractors and implements.

molded-fruit-tray.context: A molded pulp tray with round cups, some of them holding apples. Used for fruit packing, shipping trays and packaging supplies.

orchard-bin.context: A large wooden bin on skids heaped with apples, with gaps at the base for forklift tines. Marks bulk fruit harvest and storage.

apple-barrel.context: A wooden barrel with hoops, heaped with apples above the rim. Used for apple harvest, cider making and autumn orchard scenes.

berry-flat.context: A shallow tray holding a row of small square berry baskets, each topped with berries. Marks berry picking, farm stands and pick your own produce.

farm-share-box.context: An open cardboard box with leafy greens, a carrot and a leek sticking out above the flaps. Marks vegetable box subscriptions and community supported agriculture.

fruit-sizing-ring.context: A flat grading card with a row of round holes of increasing size and a fruit beside it. Used to grade fruit by diameter for packing and sale.

tulip-field.context: Rows of tulip blooms on stems receding toward a horizon line, with nearer flowers drawn larger. Marks flower farms, bulb fields and spring tourism.

sugarcane-field.context: A dense row of tall jointed cane stalks with long arching leaves at the top above the ground line. Marks sugarcane plantations and cane harvest areas.

fallow-field.context: An unplanted field of rough soil clods with a scattered weed sprig and a horizon line behind. Marks resting land, crop rotation and idle fields.

rice-fish-farming.context: A flooded paddy with rice plants rising above a wavy water line and a small fish swimming below. Marks integrated rice and fish aquaculture.

floating-garden.context: A raft of matted plant material floating on water with a row of small vegetable plants growing on top. Marks floating farms and chinampa style gardens.

potato-hilling.context: A mounded soil ridge around the stem of a leafy potato plant, with a hoe blade pulling soil toward it. Marks hilling and earthing up of potatoes and other crops.

hand-pollination.context: A small paintbrush touching the centre of an open flower with a few pollen dots nearby. Marks hand pollinating of squash, fruit trees and greenhouse crops.

fertilizer-spike.context: A tapered spike pushed into the soil beside a young plant, with its flat head above ground. Marks slow release plant food spikes for gardens and houseplants.

rockwool-cube.context: A small fibrous cube with a seedling growing out of the top, shown from above and the side. Marks rockwool grow cubes used for hydroponics and propagation.

hoeing.context: A person bent forward swinging a long handled hoe at the ground. Marks hand weeding, cultivating and manual field work.

harvesting-grain.context: A person holding a bunch of cut grain stalks in one hand and a curved sickle in the other. Marks hand reaping and traditional grain harvest.

tea-plucking.context: A person with a basket on the back reaching toward the flat top of a waist high tea bush. Marks tea picking on plantations and tea harvest work.

sowing-calendar.context: A wall calendar page with a seedling in one cell and a few other days marked. Marks planting schedules, seasonal sowing dates and garden planners.

picking-bag.context: A canvas bag worn on the chest with crossed shoulder straps, filled with apples. Marks fruit picking gear and orchard harvest equipment.

wheat-wreath.context: Two curved wheat stalks forming an open wreath with the ears meeting near the top. Marks harvest decorations, bakery branding and grain awards.
